mentions.note: did not start the club 20 mile
did well in the Essex Championship; 8th, 92m. 52s. (one letter clogged in the results; read as e, as printed clearly in the report)
won mile walk (170yds) at Paxman's, Colchester, 6m. 59 3-5s.
introduced J. A. Grimwade to the club
member of the club's walking team
succeeded H.F. King as A.J. Sawyer Cup holder (1921/2)

mentions.h: THE MEN BEHIND THE TROPHIES — J. SAWYER
mentions.note: entrant, 2 mile club walking championship 1921 (reproduced programme)
